messages:
anya: quick flag — PR #9123 for console-obsv has a bad example for session-level batching. the kv cache sample uses `kv_prefix: session_id` but our SDK expects `kv_prefix: \"session:{session_id}\"`. noticed locally when verifying cost breakdowns :grimacing:

matt: ah thanks. is that causing trace correlation to drop too?

anya: yep. because trace keys were computed from the wrong cache key, so dashboard shows double counting in per-session cost. example logs:

```
INFO 2026-03-20 14:02:12 failed to find kv cache for key: \"session_123\" (expected \"session:123\")
```

li: can you paste the snippet? I can make a tiny PR to the docs.

anya: here's the snippet from the PR (line ~45):

```
client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-1',
  kv_cache: true,
  kv_prefix: `session_${sessionId}`
})
```

li: change to:

```
kv_prefix: `session:${sessionId}`
```

sam: also add a short note about cost attribution — flushing/sharding behavior when prefix collisions happen. I can draft a 2-sentence callout.

anya: yes please. Also let's add a test snippet for tracehook header so users don't miss tracekey mapping. example header we use in backend:

```
headers['x-redwood-tracekey'] = trace.id
```

matt: I'll drop that into the PR and update the snippet files under `./docs/console/observability/snippets/`. cc @ci-bot for linting.

ci-bot: linter passed on latest commit. docs linkcheck reported one broken link: https://docs.internal/redwood/old-kv-usage -> 404

li: I'll fix the link and add a redirect note.

anya: thanks. can we ship this as a patch (small semver docs) before Friday? we want the cost dashboard rolling out Monday.

matt: yep. aiming to merge today. :shipit:

li: PR created and I added the callout about cost attribution + tracehook example. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9183

anya: reviewed — left one nit about wording. otherwise good. once merged, can someone trigger the docs build? `make docs-deploy`.

sam: i'll run the deploy after merge and watch the cost dashboard alerts for the next 2 hrs.

matt: merged. :tada:

ci-bot: docs build started: https://ci.internal/builds/7642

ci-bot: build success. deploy queued.

sam: deploy success and no anomalous cost spikes in the first 30m. thanks everyone.

anya: awesome, thanks :raised_hands:
